summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the years ending December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024. It includes reported figures under IFRS and adjustments for labour codes, highlighting operating profit, operating margin percentage, profit before income taxes, income tax expense, net profit, and basic earnings per share (EPS). Notably, the operating profit for 2025 is reported at 8,355, with an adjustment of 1,289 for labour codes, leading to an adjusted non-IFRS figure of 9,644. The operating margin shows a slight increase from 21.3% in 2024 to 21.2% in 2025. The net profit after non-controlling interests is also compared, showing a significant increase from 6,806 in 2024 to 7,625 in 2025.
